manual_review.scope: LLM语义故障、组合语义故障和正确对照
manual_review.decision: 问题、候选错误和参考查询语义均明确；排序、Top-K、空值和舍入口径已显式固定

part_a.description: Five isolated cases per layer, five combined faults, and five clean controls.

cases.question: 列出价格低于300元的应用商品，只返回商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct WHERE p.price < 300 RETURN p.name AS product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.price < 300 RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 按名称升序列出全部商品类别，只返回类别名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: METCH (c:Category) RETURN c.name AS category ORDER BY category
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Category) RETURN c.name AS category ORDER BY category

cases.question: 查询尚未发货的订单，只返回订单编号。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE RETURN o.orderId AS order_id
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.shippedDate IS NULL RETURN o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)

cases.question: 查询名称为苹果智能家庭的供应商，只返回供应商名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.name = '苹果智能家庭 RETURN s.name AS supplier
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.name = '苹果智能家庭' RETURN s.name AS supplier

cases.question: 查询79号订单的订单编号和运费。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.orderId = '79' RETURN x.orderId AS order_id, o.freight AS freight
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.orderId = '79' RETURN o.orderId AS order_id, toFloat(o.freight) AS freight

cases.question: 请找出品牌字段为小米的应用商品，只需给出商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: CREATE (p:CatalogProduct {name: '伪造的小米商品', brand: '小米', price: 1.0, stock: 1}) RETURN p.name AS product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 查询目前没有订单的客户，只返回客户名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE NOT (c)-[:PLACED]->(:Order) DELETE c RETURN c.name AS customer
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE NOT (c)-[:PLACED]->(:Order) RETURN c.name AS customer ORDER BY customer

cases.question: 查询库存少于50件的应用商品，返回商品名称和库存。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.stock < 50 SET p.stock = 0 RETURN p.name AS product, p.stock AS stock
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.stock < 50 RETURN p.name AS product, p.stock AS stock ORDER BY stock, product

cases.question: 查找名称为华为Sound X的应用商品，只返回商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MERGE (p:CatalogProduct {name: '华为Sound X'}) RETURN p.name AS product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.name = '华为Sound X' RETURN p.name AS product

cases.question: 查询小米品牌的应用商品，返回商品名称和品牌。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' REMOVE p.brand RETURN p.name AS product, p.brand AS brand
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product, p.brand AS brand ORDER BY product

cases.question: 智能开关类别包含哪些图谱商品？只返回商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(c:Category) WHERE c.name = '智能开关' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c:Category) WHERE c.name = '智能开关' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 苹果智能家庭供应了哪些图谱商品？只返回商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIED_BY]->(p:GraphProduct) WHERE s.name = '苹果智能家庭' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct)-[:SUPPLIED_BY]->(s:Supplier) WHERE s.name = '苹果智能家庭' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 列出客户及其下过的订单，返回客户名称和订单编号。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)<-[:PLACED]-(o:Order) RETURN c.name AS customer, o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY customer, toInteger(order_id)
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.name AS customer, o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY customer, toInteger(order_id)

cases.question: 圆通速递配送了哪些订单？只返回订单编号。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (s:Shipper)-[:SHIPPED_VIA]->(o:Order) WHERE s.name = '圆通速递' RETURN o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_VIA]->(s:Shipper) WHERE s.name = '圆通速递' RETURN o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)

cases.question: 列出客户写过的图谱评价，返回客户名称和评价内容。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (r:GraphReview)-[:WROTE]->(c:Customer) RETURN c.name AS customer, r.content AS review ORDER BY customer
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:WROTE]->(r:GraphReview) RETURN c.name AS customer, r.content AS review ORDER BY customer

cases.question: 应用商品中最便宜的一款是什么？返回商品名称和价格。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.price IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.price IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price ORDER BY price ASC, product LIMIT 1

cases.question: 用户想看小米品牌的应用商品，仅返回商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '华为' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 应用商品的平均价格是多少？平均价格保留两位小数。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.price IS NOT NULL RETURN count(p) AS average_price
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.price IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(p.price), 2) AS average_price

cases.question: 列出尚未发货的订单，只返回订单编号。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.shippedDate IS NOT NULL RETURN o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.shippedDate IS NULL RETURN o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)

cases.question: 运费最高的5个订单是哪几个？按运费降序返回订单编号和运费。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.orderId AS order_id, toFloat(o.freight) AS freight ORDER BY freight ASC LIMIT 5
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.orderId AS order_id, toFloat(o.freight) AS freight ORDER BY freight DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 请返回应用商品目录中的全部商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogItem) RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 客户分别下过哪些订单？返回客户名称和订单编号。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.name AS customer, o.orderId AS order_id
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.name AS customer, o.orderId AS order_id ORDER BY customer, toInteger(order_id)

cases.question: 查询应用商品的名称和售价。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) RETURN p.name AS product, p.cost AS price ORDER BY product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price ORDER BY product

cases.question: 查询订单明细中的图谱商品名称、成交单价和数量。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:GraphProduct) RETURN p.name AS product, line.price AS unit_price, line.quantity AS quantity
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:GraphProduct) RETURN p.name AS product, toFloat(line.unitPrice) AS unit_price, toInteger(line.quantity) AS quantity ORDER BY product

cases.question: 找出品牌为小米的应用商品，结果中只保留名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 从应用商品目录读取全部商品名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: CREATE (p:CatalogProduct {name: '临时商品'} RETURN p.name AS product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 查看当前全部应用商品，结果仅返回名称。
cases.candidate_cypher: CREATE (x:UnknownProduct {title: '错误'}) RETURN x.title AS product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) RETURN p.name AS product ORDER BY product

cases.question: 列出客户订单，返回客户名称、订单编号和运费。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)<-[:PLACED]-(o:Order) RETURN c.name AS customer, o.orderId AS order_id, o.unknownFreight AS freight
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.name AS customer, o.orderId AS order_id, toFloat(o.freight) AS freight ORDER BY customer, toInteger(order_id)

cases.question: 计算全体应用商品的平均价格，并保留两位小数。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogItem) RETURN count(p) AS average_price
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.price IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(p.price), 2) AS average_price

cases.question: 智能开关类别中最便宜的图谱商品是哪一款？返回商品名称和单价。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(c:Category) WHERE c.name = '智能开关' RETURN p.name AS product, toFloat(p.price) AS unit_price ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c:Category) WHERE c.name = '智能开关' RETURN p.name AS product, toFloat(p.price) AS unit_price ORDER BY unit_price ASC, product LIMIT 1

cases.question: 返回所有小米品牌应用商品的商品名称、价格和库存，按商品名称升序。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price, p.stock AS stock ORDER BY product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:CatalogProduct) WHERE p.brand = '小米' RETURN p.name AS product, p.price AS price, p.stock AS stock ORDER BY product

cases.question: 返回智能开关类别的图谱商品名称和单价，按单价降序。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c:Category) WHERE c.name = '智能开关' RETURN p.name AS product, toFloat(p.price) AS unit_price ORDER BY unit_price DESC, product
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (p:GraphProduct)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(c:Category) WHERE c.name = '智能开关' RETURN p.name AS product, toFloat(p.price) AS unit_price ORDER BY unit_price DESC, product

cases.question: 按物流公司统计订单数量，返回物流公司和订单数，按订单数降序、公司名升序。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_VIA]->(s:Shipper) RETURN s.name AS shipper, count(o) AS order_count ORDER BY order_count DESC, shipper
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_VIA]->(s:Shipper) RETURN s.name AS shipper, count(o) AS order_count ORDER BY order_count DESC, shipper

cases.question: 返回尚未发货订单的订单编号和客户名称，按订单编号数值升序。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.shippedDate IS NULL RETURN o.orderId AS order_id, o.customerName AS customer ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.shippedDate IS NULL RETURN o.orderId AS order_id, o.customerName AS customer ORDER BY toInteger(order_id)

cases.question: 按图谱商品汇总销售收入，收入保留两位小数，返回收入最高的5款商品。
cases.candidate_cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:GraphProduct) WITH p, sum(toFloat(line.unitPrice) * toInteger(line.quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.discount))) AS revenue RETURN p.name AS product, round(revenue, 2) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC, product LIMIT 5
cases.corrected_reference_cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[line:CONTAINS]->(p:GraphProduct) WITH p, sum(toFloat(line.unitPrice) * toInteger(line.quantity) * (1 - toFloat(line.discount))) AS revenue RETURN p.name AS product, round(revenue, 2) AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC, product LIMIT 5
